field.name: referenceNumber
field.description: Vendor or other invoice number.

field.name: currencyUomId
field.description: The original (external) currency

field.name: overrideOrgPartyId
field.description: Used to specify the organization override rather than using the fromPartyId and/or toPartyId (depending on which is an internal org).

field.name: productStoreId
field.description: For sales invoices processed through a ProductStore, copied from order if applicable

field.name: partyRelationshipId
field.description: For Payroll invoices, points to Employment record

field.name: timePeriodId
field.description: For Payroll invoices, points to Payroll TimePeriod

field.name: externalId
field.description: ID for the invoice in the direct upstream system it came from if it came from an external system

field.name: originId
field.description: ID for the invoice in the original system it came from if not the direct upstream system

field.name: appliedPaymentsTotal
field.description: Total of all PaymentApplication records by invoiceId or toInvoiceId, ie includes payments and invoices applied to/from this invoice.

field.name: overrideGlAccountId
field.description: The override or actual glAccountId used for the AcctgTransEntry based on the InvoiceItem. If empty the glAccountId will be determined based on configuration or custom code.

field.name: assetId
field.description: For sale of a particular asset, required for fixed assets

field.name: billThruVendorName
field.description: For tracking purposes when there is no associated bill through invoice with InvoiceItemAssoc records

field.name: taxAuthorityRateId
field.description: For a calculated tax line, the rate version applied.

field.name: taxableAmount
field.description: For a calculated tax line, its base.

field.name: taxPercentage
field.description: For a calculated tax line, its rate.

field.name: taxRoundingAmount
field.description: For a calculated tax line, its amount less the unrounded tax.

field.name: taxCalculated
field.description: Y for a tax line a tax gateway calculated (calculate#InvoiceSalesTax), which a new calculation replaces; manual tax lines are left as they are.

field.name: orderPmtServiceRegisterId
field.description: Use ServiceRegister.serviceTypeEnumId = 'SettleTermOrderPmt'; service will receive in-parameters: orderId, orderPartSeqId, and settlementTermId

entity.description: A collection contact or next action of an organization with a customer. The activity itself is a WorkEffort (a call, email or to-do, linked to the customer by WorkEffortRecord, so it shows on the customer's record and in the collector's Today); this row adds the organization and the outcome.

field.name: invoiceIds
field.description: The invoices it is about, comma separated.

entity.description: A customer's promise to pay an organization an amount by a date, with the invoices it covers. It is kept when the customer's payments received from its date through the promised day reach the amount, and broken when the day passes first; it never marks an invoice paid.

field.name: invoiceIds
field.description: The invoices it covers, comma separated.

field.name: workEffortId
field.description: The collection activity that recorded it.

entity.description: A level of an organization's payment reminders, as effective-dated rows with audit-logged fields: from how many days overdue it applies, how many days must pass before the same customer gets this level again, the email template and whether disputed invoices are left out (CollectionServices.store#Level).

field.name: previousLevelId
field.description: The row this one replaced.

entity.description: A reminder run of an organization as of a day: its notices, previewed, then sent. Sending again sends only the notices not yet sent.

field.name: incomplete
field.description: Y when more overdue invoices were found than one run takes.

entity.description: A reminder of a run: one customer, currency and level, the overdue invoices it names (invoiceIds) and their amount, its key (organization, customer, currency and level: a customer is not reminded at the same level again within the level's cadence), the recipients and the outcome of sending it. A row with status DntExcluded names invoices left out and why (disputed, held by a promise, covered by credits, sent recently).

An invoice-only cadence (rent, a retainer, a recurring supplier bill): the template invoice whose lines each occurrence copies into a new draft, the interval, the first and last days and the next day due. A change applies to the occurrences not yet made; each made occurrence keeps its invoice. Order-based recurring billing stays on the order (OrderHeader.recurCronExpression and the create_RecurringOrders job).

field.name: partyId
field.description: The customer, or the supplier of a recurring bill.

field.name: intervalUomId
field.description: TF_wk, TF_mon or TF_yr.

field.name: nextDate
field.description: The day of the next occurrence to make.

entity.description: One period of a schedule, keyed by its day: the draft invoice it made, or why making it failed. A period makes one invoice however often generation is retried.

A hold on a bill: while it is open (no releasedDate) the bill is not approved and no payment is applied to it. Placed by hold#Invoice, a release asked for by request#HoldRelease and released by another user through release#InvoiceHold.

field.name: reviewDate
field.description: When the hold is to be reviewed or released; it is not released by itself.

entity.description: One portion of a payment term, as effective-dated rows: a share of the invoice due a number of days after the invoice date, and an early-payment discount taken when paid within its days. A term without lines in effect is one portion due on its own date with no discount. A change ends the lines in effect and starts the next (store#SettlementTerm); an issued invoice keeps its own InvoiceDueSchedule.

field.name: portionPercent
field.description: The share of the invoice total this line makes due; a term's lines in effect add up to 100.

field.name: daysBasis
field.description: Days after the invoice date the portion is due.

field.name: discountDays
field.description: Days after the invoice date within which the discount may be taken.

entity.description: What an issued invoice is due and when, written once when it is issued (finalized, or approved for a bill) from its term's lines in effect on the invoice date: each portion's due date and amount, and the discount and the last day it may be taken. A later change of the term never changes it. Aging, the workbenches, payment runs and apply#Settlement read it (InvoiceServices.get#InvoiceDueSchedule). Its rows are not audit-logged: they are written once at issue and removed only when the invoice goes back for changes (Resume Changes), both recorded in the invoice's own status audit log.

field.name: dueDate
field.description: A calendar day: the invoice's book day and the portion's days.

field.name: discountDate
field.description: The last calendar day the discount may be taken.

entity.description: A supplier's bill submitted from a public page (submit#SupplierBill): its order, reference and the incoming draft bill it made or found. A repeat of the operation, or of the supplier's reference, answers this row. The file is scanned before the bill is made, and its name and size are kept here.

How an organization matches its suppliers' bills, as effective-dated rows: a change ends the row in effect and starts the next (store#MatchPolicy). A row for a product wins over one for a category of the product, which wins over the organization's row (no product and no category). A match line keeps the row it applied.

field.name: billBasisEnumId
field.description: ImbReceived: a bill line matches the accepted quantity of the order line's receipts (three-way); ImbOrdered: the ordered quantity (two-way).

field.name: receiptRequired
field.description: Y: on the ordered basis a line whose order line has no accepted receipt is a match exception.

field.name: serviceAcceptanceRequired
field.description: The service-acceptance rule (impl-manufacturing P14): Y or empty, on the received basis a service line (a PtService product) matches the quantity its ServiceAcceptance rows accepted, since a service has no receipt; N, a service line matches its ordered quantity.

field.name: varianceActionEnumId
field.description: ImaHold: a variance outside tolerance holds the bill (IhrMatchException); ImaWarn: it is named and the bill is not held.

field.name: selfBillingDefault
field.description: Y: a supplier's first profile row takes self-billing unless the change says otherwise (store#SupplierProfile).

entity.description: A bill's applied match (apply#InvoiceMatch, apply#LegacyMatches): its lines are the allocations to order lines and receipts, written also as OrderItemBilling. Unapplying ends it (ImUnapplied) and reverses the billing links; a bill has at most one applied match. A source change marks it stale (staleDate, by queue#MatchReevaluation) until the re-evaluation job evaluates it again.

field.name: isLegacy
field.description: Y: linked by the legacy backfill from existing billing and receipt evidence.

field.name: invoiceHoldId
field.description: The match exception hold the match placed, if any.

entity.description: One line of a match: a bill line's quantity allocated to an order line, and to one of its receipts on the received basis, with the snapshot it was checked against (ordered, accepted, held and earlier billed quantity, the prices), the policy row applied and the line's exception; or a bill line with no source, named as an exception. orderItemBillingId is the billing link it wrote or updated; previousQuantity the link's quantity before (null when the match created it), which unapply restores.

field.name: heldQuantity
field.description: Accepted quantity still held for inspection, left out of the match (CX-QUALITY's get#SourceInspectionStatus).

field.name: exceptionCodes
field.description: Every exception code of the line, comma-separated; the re-evaluation holds a bill again only for a code not recorded here.

field.name: receiptLinked
field.description: Y: the match set the receipt's invoice, which unapply clears.

entity.description: One receipt line's share of a landed cost charge (a freight, duty or broker line of a bill), posted by post#LandedCost: the share of the receipt's stock still on hand raised that asset's cost, the share already issued went to cost of goods sold or production variance, and the charge account was credited. A charge line is allocated once (LcaPosted); its rows keep the basis and amounts it was allocated by.

field.name: basisValue
field.description: The receipt line's measure in the basis: its accepted quantity, value, weight or volume
